title: WorldEvent
description: Payload of a world_event message. Validated, structured outcome the game client executes. The first four event types acknowledge a player_action; the rest are consequences produced by the Phase 2 runtime (docs/RUNTIME.md) and carry payload.source. dialogue_started carries payload.npc_id, payload.text and, only when the line was voiced, payload.audio_url: a path on the backend HTTP origin (GET /audio/<uuid>, docs/VOICE.md). Source of truth: backend/src/action.rs.

event_id.description: UUIDv5 derived from action_id (or, for runtime consequences, from the causing action or Director decision): deterministic.
